# 27 September 2025
#
# We modified the TICC time-of-flight calculation to use 32 bit
# operations whereever possible, and to return tof as a uint32
# instead of 64 bit.  This should speed things up.
#
# We were concerned about possible overflows in the calculation by
# using 32 bit variables, so set up a test.
#
# A function generator was used to provide a nominal 1 Hz pulse train
# to the TICC chO input.  The TICC was started in "Debug" mode that prints
# the raw TDC register values, as well as other calculation results, and
# for this test the calculated time of flight using both the original and
# the new algorithms.
#
# While logging the TICC output, I manually adjusted the function
# generator output frequency in steps of 100 uHz in both directions
# around the nominal.  I deliberately made changes of different sizes
# to exercise the range of the TDC7200 results.
#
# I then had the Cursor AI agent analyze the data to see what the range of
# register values was, and to test the correlation of tof results using the
# old and new algorithms.  Those results are below, and show that the new
# algorithm works successfully and that the register ranges stayed well within
# values that will work with 32 bit variables.
# 
# The actual data set is below.
#
# TICC TOF Optimization Validation Test Results
# STATISTICAL ANALYSIS:
# 
# Register Value Ranges Observed:
# time1Result (START to next 100ns tick): 46 to 1900 (24-bit register, max: 16,777,215)
# time2Result (100ns tick to STOP): 168 to 1259 (relatively stable)
# clock1Result (number of 100ns ticks): 33 to 996 (significant variation across frequency sweep)
# cal1Result (calibration 1): 1819 to 1821 (very stable, as expected)
# cal2Result (calibration 2): 36369 to 36413 (relatively stable, as expected)
#
# TOF Calculation Performance:
# TOF Range Coverage: 3,298,181 to 99,635,085 picoseconds (3.3μs to 99.6μs)
# Range: Excellent coverage of the 0-100μs measurement window
#
# Accuracy Analysis:
# Perfect matches (0 picosecond difference): ~60% of measurements
# 1 picosecond difference: ~40% of measurements
# Maximum difference observed: 1 picosecond (0.0000000001%)
#
#
# TEST DATA:
